welcome.title:
Better together.

welcome.subtitle: Care for your pet, get outside, and meet people who love theirs as much as you do.

auth.signInHint: You'll approve a quick signature in Nimiq Pay. It proves the wallet is yours and doesn't send any funds.

auth.installHint: Don't have Nimiq Pay yet? Install it first, then come back and tap the button.
auth.cantOpen: Couldn't open Nimiq Pay. Make sure it's installed.

onboarding.privacyNote: Only an approximate area is used. Your address is never shown to others.
onboarding.notifLater: We'll ask for notification permission when you first need it.
onboarding.gpsLater: Location is only requested if you start a walk, and never shared precisely.
onboarding.communitiesSoon: Communities and weekly challenges are coming
onboarding.communitiesSoonBody: Local groups, group walks and challenges arrive in upcoming releases. Your interests will help match you.
onboarding.noCommunitiesBody: You can start one from the Community tab.
onboarding.communityPaidBody: Join groups and events with a monthly payment. You can unlock it any time from the Community tab. Pet care is free.

home.walkSoon: Walk tracking is coming soon. For now, keep your pet's care on track below.
home.noPetBody: Profiles, weight, medication and reminders all start here.
home.enablePush: Turn on notifications so reminders reach you on time
home.challengeSoonBody: A new challenge is posted every week. Join in and climb the leaderboard.
home.communityLockedBody: Events and groups are for members. Tap to unlock.
home.challengeLockedBody: Unlock the community to join this week's challenge and the leaderboard.

community.title: Community
community.subtitle: Meet pet lovers, join groups, and create real-life adventures
community.soonBody: Local groups, member-hosted events and the Monthly Paw Walk arrive in an upcoming release.
community.feedDiscover: You haven't joined a group yet. Here's what's happening in popular communities.

community.joinToPost: Join this community to post and comment.

community.noPostsMember: Be the first to share something.
community.noResultsBody: Try another word, or start this community yourself.
community.noneYetBody: Be the first to start one for your area or breed.
community.postGone: This post is no longer available.
community.rulesNote: Be kind. Communities are moderated, and members can report and block.
community.slowDown: You're posting very quickly. Please wait a moment.

med.finishBody: Stop reminders for {{name}} and move it to history.
med.disclaimer: PawCircle records and reminds. It does not diagnose or recommend medication. Always follow your veterinarian's instructions.

settings.title: Account
settings.petCareAlways: Your pet-care records and reminders always stay available, on any plan.

push.denied: Permission was denied. You can change it in system settings.
push.unsupported: Push notifications aren't available on this device.
push.no_project: Push needs an Expo (EAS) project ID. See the README.

settings.deleteBody: This permanently erases your pets, health records and reminders. It can't be undone.

membership.required: Community is for members. Unlock it to continue.

nearby.chooseBody: We only use your prefecture, never your address, to show communities and events near you.
nearby.noCommunities: No communities in this area yet
nearby.noEvents: No events in this area yet

events.independentNote: Members organise events independently. PawCircle provides the platform and guidelines but doesn't supervise gatherings.
events.instructionsHint: What to bring, where to meet, rules for pets
events.name: Event name
events.noneBody: Host one, or check back soon.
events.publicPlace: This is a public place (like a park or café), not a private home. I'll never share my address.
events.reminderNote: We'll remind you before it starts.
events.safetyNote: Meet in public, keep pets leashed or carried, and only let pets greet when both owners agree. Hosts organise independently; in an emergency call 119 (ambulance) or 110 (police).

safety.blockBody: You won't see their posts, comments or events, and they won't see yours.
safety.reportIntro: Tell us what's wrong. Our team reviews reports, and content reported by several people is hidden until reviewed.
safety.thanksBody: We'll review it. You can also block the person so you no longer see their content.

paywall.title: Unlock the PawCircle community
paywall.subtitle: Meet pet owners near you, join groups and walk together.
paywall.b2: Post, comment and chat with other owners
paywall.b3: Host and join group walks and meetups
paywall.freeNote: Pet care, reminders and your health records always stay free.

unlock.title: Unlock community
unlock.insideBody: Approve the payment in Nimiq Pay. We confirm it on the Nimiq blockchain, then unlock the community.
unlock.manualBody: Send the exact amount to this address and include the message, so we can match your payment to your account.
unlock.messageWarn: Without the message we can't match your payment automatically.
unlock.noWallet: No Nimiq wallet app could be opened. Copy the details above instead.
unlock.tipInside: Tip: open PawCircle inside the Nimiq Pay app to pay in one tap.
unlock.searching: Looking for your payment on the Nimiq network…
unlock.stillWaiting: We haven't seen your payment confirm yet. If you've paid, give it a minute and tap check again.
unlock.successBody: Your payment is confirmed. Welcome to the PawCircle community.
unlock.unavailableBody: We're still setting up Nimiq payments. Pet care stays fully free in the meantime.
unlock.cannotStart: Couldn't start the payment. Please try again.
unlock.checkFailed: Couldn't check your payment. Please try again.
unlock.payFailed: The payment didn't go through. You haven't been charged unless it shows in your wallet.
unlock.invalid: That payment doesn't match this request.
unlock.alreadyUsed: That transaction was already used for another payment.
unlock.wrongNetwork: Nimiq Pay is on {{host}} but this payment needs {{expected}}.

reasons.wrong_recipient: That payment was sent to a different address.
reasons.amount_too_low: That payment was less than the price.
reasons.wrong_reference: That payment didn't include the message from this request.
reasons.transaction_failed: That transaction failed on the network.

unlock.footer: Payments are made in NIM on the Nimiq blockchain and confirmed by our server. Blockchain payments are final, so please check the details before approving.

challenges.title: Challenge
challenges.noneBody: A new challenge is posted every week. Check back soon!
challenges.noPrizes: Challenges are for fun and bragging rights. Climb the leaderboard, no prizes needed.
challenges.limits: Up to {{max}} at a time and {{cap}} per day. Rest days are good for pets too.
challenges.dayHint: Walk or play with your pet today, then check in. One check-in per day.
challenges.checkInHint: Did it? Check in. Counts once each time, up to the daily limit.
challenges.needPet: Add a pet of the right kind to take part.
challenges.honesty: Entries are self-reported until walk tracking arrives. Please be honest. Unrealistic entries are removed.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.chooseArea: Choose your area to see how you compare with people near you.
leaderboard.noCommunityBody: Join a community to see its leaderboard.
leaderboard.emptyBody: Be the first on the board. Log some activity!
leaderboard.noChallengeBody: Rankings appear as soon as a weekly challenge starts.

chat.title: Chat
chat.intro: Talk with the whole community, people near you, or one of your groups.
chat.noAreaBody: Choose a prefecture to chat with people near you.
chat.noGroupsBody: Join a community to chat with its members.
chat.emptyBody: Nobody has written here yet. Start the conversation!
chat.rules: Be kind. You can report or block anyone from a message's … menu.

admin.noneBody: Post this week's challenge to get the leaderboard going.
admin.formNote: You're posting as PawCircle. Members see this on Home and in Activities once it's published.
admin.title: Title
admin.goalHint: Shows a progress bar. Leave empty for none.
admin.capsNote: Limits keep the leaderboard fair and safe. Leave blank for sensible defaults.
admin.entriesNote: {{count}} players. Highest first, so unrealistic scores stand out.
